extracted.intended_audience: mathematics researchers preparing manuscripts to submit to the Duke Mathematical Journal
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for preparing and submitting research papers to the Duke Mathematical Journal, covering formatting, file types, metadata, accessibility, and submission procedures. Targeted at authors planning to submit original mathematical research to DMJ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and exclusive submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of a paper to the Duke Mathematical Journal acknowledges that the paper is original and is not submitted elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must ensure the work is original and not under consideration by another journal; upon acceptance authors must make standard copyright assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission system and method
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should submit their papers online using the EditFlow manuscript peer-review system at https://ef.msp.org/submit/duke.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not upload a revision as a new submission; use the status link from the submission email to upload a revision. Withdraw only to completely remove a paper from consideration. If the revision button is not available, contact the journal via the “Send a Message” button or dmj@math.duke.edu / editflow@msp.org for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required PDF file at submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Be prepared to provide a PDF of the manuscript when submitting a paper to DMJ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PDF is the primary file required at submission time; other source files are requested at acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: LaTeX class, font size, paper size, and margins
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions should be typeset in 11-point font using the amslatex class file (or equivalent) with US letter page and standard margins: \documentclass[11pt,letterpaper]{amsart}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To create a level playing field and get an accurate idea of relative lengths, do not use packages that override LaTeX defaults (e.g., fullpage, geometry, anysize, typearea, koma-script). If formatted correctly, the text area should measure 5 in by 8 in (about 12.7 cm by 20.3 cm). Please check this before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide LaTeX source and supplemental files at acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: At acceptance, provide a copy of the manuscript in LaTeX2e, as well as all figures, style files, and any other supplemental files needed to process the paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare to supply the source files and any additional materials required for production; failure to provide necessary files could delay publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mathematics Subject Classifications (MSC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide 2020 Mathematics Subject Classifications. If there are primary and secondary numbers, indicate them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include MSC codes as part of the submission metadata so the paper can be properly classified and indexed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract length and language rules
rubrics_metrics.description: An abstract of no more than 300 words is required. The journal prefers that the abstract be submitted as part of the paper. Papers written in French should include versions of the abstract in both English and French.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep abstracts concise (≤300 words) and include them in the manuscript file; if writing in French, include bilingual abstracts to meet the journal's preference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alt text for figures and images (accessibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to a caption, each figure and image requires alt text, a short description that allows nonsighted persons to access a publication’s visual content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At acceptance be prepared to include a Word document listing all the alt text descriptions in your article and their page numbers. Use the provided resources (Accessible Latex and Making Accessible Documents) to prepare accessible figures and documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant information disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide grant information for authors where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include funding acknowledgments and grant numbers as part of the submission so the journal can include them in the published article's metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Running head length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a running head (a shortened version of the title) of no more than 50 characters, including spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a concise running head ≤50 characters to be used in the journal header.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color figures policy and fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Color figures and images may be used in the online version of the article at no charge. If the use of color is essential for the print version, however, then authors will be required to pay a fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the DMJ production office at dmj@dukeupress.edu for information about print-color fees. Note: there are no article processing charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and access procedures for online/institutional access
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural information for online access activation (Project Euclid) and institutional site license/ordering requirements is provided for subscribers and institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual access: create a Project Euclid account and follow activation steps; Institutional access: prepayment and signed site license agreement required with appropriate IP addresses and customer number. These are administrative requirements rather than manuscript-quality criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not resubmit previous submission as new
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not upload a revision of a previously submitted article as a new submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the status link in the submission email to upload revisions. If the revision upload button is not present, contact the journal to request that a revision be enabled. Withdraw only if you wish to completely remove your paper from consideration.
